observations: The 106-aa query sequence is an exact full-length sequence match to reviewed UniProt FlhD Q3JY54 from Burkholderia pseudomallei strain 1710b.

Annotated localization is cytoplasm; annotated assembly contains two FlhC and four FlhD subunits, with FlhD forming dimers.
Sequence-derived estimates: molecular weight 11,593 Da, pI 5.85, GRAVY 0.1425, and predicted charge at pH 7 of -2.23.
No catalytic reaction was retrieved; available evidence supports a transcription regulator rather than an enzyme.
